Manuel Valls, Premier ministre, et des autres membres du Gouvernement' and closes 'Fait le 6 décembre 2016.', signed 'François Hollande'.

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-38 only (Premier ministre; the Prime Ministers appointed from 31 March 2014 to the 7 September 2026 cutoff, the next batch after CLAUDE-C01-37). The Prime Minister's letter presenting the Government's resignation, the decree ending the Government's functions, the decree appointing a Prime Minister and a decree the Prime Minister signs stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row.
